ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَ كُفَّ بِهَا عَنَّا الْأَسْوَاءَ وَالْبَلْوَى . [وَ الْأَمْرَاضِ]
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa kuffa bi hā `annā ‘l-aswā’a wa ‘l-balwā [wa ‘l-amrāḍ].
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and avert from us thereby all trial and tribulation [and sickness]!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَ الْطُفْ بِنَا بِبَرَكَاتِهَا فِي السِّرِّ وَ النَّجْوَى .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘lṭuf bi nā bi barakātihā fi ‘s-sirri wa ‘n-najwā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and be kind to us thereby secretly and in secret council!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَ سَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ ذَوِي الْمَقَامِ الْأَعْلَى وَ السِّرِّ الْأَجْلَى .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Dha wī ‘l-maqāmi ‘l-a`lā wa ‘s-sirri ‘l-ajlā.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family those of highest ranks and the most sublime secret!
